s: 奶奶坐在沙发上聊天着。
s_py: nǎi nǎi zuò zài shā fā shàng liáo tiān zhe
zh: 奶奶坐在沙发上聊着天。
py: nǎi nǎi zuò zài shā fā shàng liáo zhe tiān
en: Grandma is sitting on the sofa chatting.
why: 着 belongs right after the verb 聊 and before the object 天. Putting it after 聊天 treats the whole word as one verb.

task: Say Mum is angry with me, using 生.
zh: 妈妈很生我的气。
py: mā mā hěn shēng wǒ de qì
en: Mum is very angry with me.
why: To name the person you are angry with, put 我的 between 生 and 气.

task: Say Mum has finished her shower.
zh: 妈妈洗完澡了。
py: mā mā xǐ wán zǎo le
en: Mum has finished her shower.
why: Add the result 完 right after 洗, before 澡, and end with 了: 洗完澡了.

s: 他唱歌唱得不好。
s_py: tā chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo
zh: 他唱歌唱得不好。
py: tā chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo
en: He doesn't sing well.
why: Negation goes in the description, after 得: 唱得不好. This is correct, and 不唱歌唱得好 would be the error.

q: 她女儿跳舞___，上个月还在全国比赛里得了第一名。
zh: 她女儿跳舞跳得非常好，上个月还在全国比赛里得了第一名。
py: tā nǚ ér tiào wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo shàng gè yuè hái zài quán guó bǐ sài lǐ dé le dì yì míng
en: Her daughter dances extremely well and even won first place in a national competition last month.
why: After 跳舞 the verb must repeat so that 得 follows it: 跳得非常好. 得非常好 and 跳舞得非常好 put 得 after the noun 舞.

zh: 哥哥做饭做得很好。
py: gē gē zuò fàn zuò de hěn hǎo
en: My older brother cooks very well.
why: 做饭 is followed by a repeated 做 and then 得: 做饭做得很好. 做饭得很好 leaves 得 after the noun.

s: 妈妈今天很忙，你去帮忙她吧。
s_py: mā mā jīn tiān hěn máng nǐ qù bāng máng tā ba
zh: 妈妈今天很忙，你去帮她的忙吧。
py: mā mā jīn tiān hěn máng nǐ qù bāng tā de máng ba
en: Mum is busy today, so go and help her out.
why: 帮忙 already contains its object 忙, so 她 cannot follow it. The person goes inside as 帮她的忙.

zh: 我吃完饭了。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn le
en: I have finished eating.
why: The result word 完 goes right after the verb 吃 and before 饭: 吃完饭. 了 closes the sentence.

s: 她跳舞得非常漂亮。
s_py: tā tiào wǔ de fēi cháng piào liàng
zh: 她跳舞跳得非常漂亮。
py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de fēi cháng piào liàng
en: She dances beautifully.
why: 得 cannot attach to the noun 舞. The verb 跳 must repeat after the object: 跳舞跳得.

q: 顾客不小心弄坏了商品，应该___老板道歉。
zh: 顾客不小心弄坏了商品，应该向老板道歉。
py: gù kè bù xiǎo xīn nòng huài le shāng pǐn yīng gāi xiàng lǎo bǎn dào qiàn
en: The customer accidentally broke the goods and should apologise to the shop owner.
why: 道歉 has no slot for the person apologised to, so that person is introduced before the verb with 向 (or 跟). 把, 被 and 从 cannot mark the person you apologise to.

s: 她还在生气我，因为我打碎了她的杯子。
s_py: tā hái zài shēng qì wǒ yīn wèi wǒ dǎ suì le tā de bēi zi
zh: 她还在生我的气，因为我打碎了她的杯子。
py: tā hái zài shēng wǒ de qì yīn wèi wǒ dǎ suì le tā de bēi zi
en: She is still angry with me because I broke her cup.
why: 生气 cannot take 我 after it; the person goes inside as 生我的气.

q: 姐姐周末要___她的朋友见面。
zh: 姐姐周末要跟她的朋友见面。
py: jiě jiě zhōu mò yào gēn tā de péng yǒu jiàn miàn
en: My older sister is meeting her friend this weekend.
why: 见面 already holds its object 面, so the other person must come before the verb with 跟. 把 and 对 cannot link a person to 见面 this way, and 给 would mean meeting on someone's behalf.

task: Say you took a quick shower (了 + 个).
zh: 我洗了个澡。
py: wǒ xǐ le gè zǎo
en: I took a quick shower.
why: Casual 个 goes inside the word and 了 follows the verb: 洗了个澡.

src_py: tā men zài kè tīng liáo tiān
task: Say they are having a casual chat (double the verb).
zh: 他们在客厅聊聊天。
py: tā men zài kè tīng liáo liáo tiān
en: They are having a little chat in the living room.
why: 聊聊天 doubles only 聊 and keeps 天 once; the place phrase stays before the verb.

s: 他在给邻居帮忙，晚点才回来。
s_py: tā zài gěi lín jū bāng máng wǎn diǎn cái huí lái
zh: 他在给邻居帮忙，晚点才回来。
py: tā zài gěi lín jū bāng máng wǎn diǎn cái huí lái
en: He is helping the neighbours out and will be back later.
why: Putting the helped person in front with 给 is a normal way to use 帮忙. The person does not follow the word, so nothing is wrong.

src_py: mā mā qǐng jià qǐng le sān tiān
task: Put the duration inside the word, with 了.
zh: 妈妈请了三天假。
py: mā mā qǐng le sān tiān jià
en: Mum took three days of leave.
why: Instead of repeating the verb, move the duration inside: 请了三天假, with 了 after 请 and the amount before 假.

q: 我们以前没见___面，今天是第一次。
zh: 我们以前没见过面，今天是第一次。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián méi jiàn guo miàn jīn tiān shì dì yī cì
en: We have never met before; today is the first time.
why: 过 marks experience and attaches to the verb half: 没见过面. 没 cannot be followed by 了, 着 does not mean experience, and 完 would mean finishing.

zh: 他们结婚十年了。
py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le
en: They have been married for ten years.
why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time since goes after the whole word and 了 closes the sentence: 结婚十年了.

q: 弟弟昨天睡觉睡___很晚，今天起不来。
zh: 弟弟昨天睡觉睡得很晚，今天起不来。
py: dì di zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn jīn tiān qǐ bù lái
en: My younger brother went to bed very late last night, so he can't get up today.
why: The repeated verb 睡 takes 得 to link to the description 很晚. 地 is for adverbs before verbs, and 着 and 过 are aspect markers.

zh: 他游泳游得很快。
py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
en: He swims very fast.
why: The verb repeats after the object so that 得 attaches to it: 游泳游得很快.

s: 奶奶每天午饭后都睡半个小时觉。
s_py: nǎi nǎi měi tiān wǔ fàn hòu dōu shuì bàn gè xiǎo shí jiào
zh: 奶奶每天午饭后都睡半个小时觉。
py: nǎi nǎi měi tiān wǔ fàn hòu dōu shuì bàn gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: Grandma sleeps for half an hour after lunch every day.
why: The duration sits inside 睡觉 even without 了, because this is a habit. 睡半个小时觉 is correct, so do not move the time to the end.

q: 我弟弟今年六月___毕业，现在在找工作。
zh: 我弟弟今年六月大学毕业，现在在找工作。
py: wǒ dì di jīn nián liù yuè dà xué bì yè xiàn zài zài zhǎo gōng zuò
en: My younger brother graduated from university this June and is now looking for a job.
why: The school goes in front of 毕业 as a plain noun (大学毕业). Adding 给, 把 or 对 before it turns it into a phrase that does not exist, and the school can never come after 毕业.

q: 他结过两___婚，现在一个人住。
zh: 他结过两次婚，现在一个人住。
py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn xiàn zài yí gè rén zhù
en: He has been married twice and now lives alone.
why: Times of an event use 次, placed between 过 and 婚: 结过两次婚. 个 does not count marriages, and 遍 and 场 are not used with 结婚.

q: 我昨天睡___八个小时觉。
zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.
why: A completed activity with a duration needs 了 right after the verb half, before the amount: 睡了八个小时觉. 过 would mean a past experience in general, and 着 or 完 do not fit a measured completed sleep.

q: 弟弟弄坏了我的手机，我很___他的气。
zh: 弟弟弄坏了我的手机，我很生他的气。
py: dì di nòng huài le wǒ de shǒu jī wǒ hěn shēng tā de qì
en: My younger brother broke my phone and I am very angry with him.
why: Inside 生…气 the person goes as 他的, and the verb 生 must stay in front. 对, 跟 and 和 can introduce a person before 生气, but they cannot sit directly in front of 他的气.

s: 他们离婚三年了，孩子跟妈妈住。
s_py: tā men lí hūn sān nián le hái zi gēn mā mā zhù
zh: 他们离婚三年了，孩子跟妈妈住。
py: tā men lí hūn sān nián le hái zi gēn mā mā zhù
en: They have been divorced for three years, and the child lives with Mum.
why: 离婚 is a point event, so time since goes after the whole word with 了 at the end. This is correct, and 离了三年婚 would be the error.

s: 你别担心我，我一个人在家没问题。
s_py: nǐ bié dān xīn wǒ wǒ yí gè rén zài jiā méi wèn tí
zh: 你别担心我，我一个人在家没问题。
py: nǐ bié dān xīn wǒ wǒ yí gè rén zài jiā méi wèn tí
en: Don't worry about me; I'll be fine at home alone.
why: This looks like the 结婚 pattern but 担心 is the exception in this family: it freely takes an object, so 担心我 is correct and nothing needs moving.

zh: 孩子们在院子里跳着舞。
py: hái zi men zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào zhe wǔ
en: The children are dancing in the yard.
why: 着 attaches to the verb half 跳 and the object 舞 follows: 跳着舞. 跳舞着 would put 着 after the noun.

q: 我的钱包丢了，多亏你帮了我这么大的___，真不知道怎么感谢你。
zh: 我的钱包丢了，多亏你帮了我这么大的忙，真不知道怎么感谢你。
py: wǒ de qián bāo diū le duō kuī nǐ bāng le wǒ zhè me dà de máng zhēn bù zhī dào zěn me gǎn xiè nǐ
en: My wallet was lost and thanks to you helping me so much, I really don't know how to thank you.
why: 帮…的忙 splits 帮忙 around the person and 的; 这么大的 describes the 忙. 气, 面 and 觉 are the second halves of other separable verbs and cannot be paired with 帮.

zh: 昨晚我没睡好觉。
py: zuó wǎn wǒ méi shuì hǎo jiào
en: I didn't sleep well last night.
why: 好 is a result placed inside the word between 睡 and 觉. 睡觉好 would not mean this.

q: 晚饭后，我们在客厅聊___聊天，然后就睡觉了。
zh: 晚饭后，我们在客厅聊了聊天，然后就睡觉了。
py: wǎn fàn hòu wǒ men zài kè tīng liáo le liáo tiān rán hòu jiù shuì jiào le
en: After dinner we had a little chat in the living room and then went to bed.
why: A finished brief action puts 了 between the two copies of the verb: 聊了聊天. 着, 过 and 的 cannot go between the doubled verbs.

s: 周末我们去公园散步散步吧。
s_py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn bù sàn bù ba
zh: 周末我们去公园散散步吧。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn sàn bù ba
en: Let's go for a little walk in the park at the weekend.
why: Separable verbs double only the first half. 散步散步 copies the whole word as if it were 休息.

q: 我哥哥大学毕业___两年了，现在在上海上班。
zh: 我哥哥大学毕业两年了，现在在上海上班。
py: wǒ gē gē dà xué bì yè liǎng nián le xiàn zài zài shàng hǎi shàng bān
en: It has been two years since my older brother graduated from university, and now he works in Shanghai.
why: 毕业 is a point event, so the time elapsed since it follows the whole word: 毕业两年了. Putting 了 or 过 inside the word would turn it into something that lasted.

s: 我今天想早点回家，睡个好觉。
s_py: wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā shuì gè hǎo jiào
zh: 我今天想早点回家，睡个好觉。
py: wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā shuì gè hǎo jiào
en: I want to go home early today and get a good night's sleep.
why: 睡个好觉 is correct: 个 plus a describing word goes inside the word, like 洗个热水澡. Nothing here needs fixing.

q: 我还没吃___饭，等我一下。
zh: 我还没吃完饭，等我一下。
py: wǒ hái méi chī wán fàn děng wǒ yī xià
en: I haven't finished eating yet; wait for me a moment.
why: Result words go between the halves: 吃完饭. 还没 stresses an unfinished result, so 完 is needed; 了 and 过 do not carry that meaning.

s: 孩子睡不着觉，一直在床上翻来翻去。
s_py: hái zi shuì bù zháo jiào yì zhí zài chuáng shàng fān lái fān qù
zh: 孩子睡不着觉，一直在床上翻来翻去。
py: hái zi shuì bù zháo jiào yì zhí zài chuáng shàng fān lái fān qù
en: The child can't sleep and keeps tossing and turning in bed.
why: 睡不着觉 is correct: the potential 不着 sits inside the word. The tempting error 睡觉不着 is what a learner would write.

q: 我一个人搬不了这个沙发，你能来___吗？
zh: 我一个人搬不了这个沙发，你能来帮帮忙吗？
py: wǒ yí gè rén bān bù liǎo zhè ge shā fā nǐ néng lái bāng bāng máng ma
en: I can't move this sofa on my own; can you come and lend a hand?
why: The first half doubles: 帮帮忙. 帮忙帮忙 treats the word as an ordinary two-syllable verb. 帮忙忙 and 忙帮忙 are not possible forms.

q: 你生___气？是不是有人惹你了？
zh: 你生什么气？是不是有人惹你了？
py: nǐ shēng shén me qì shì bú shì yǒu rén rě nǐ le
en: What are you angry about? Did someone upset you?
why: 什么 goes inside the word as a question word: 生什么气. 怎么, 为什么 and 哪里 are placed before the verb, not inside it.

s: 你能帮我忙一个吗？
s_py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ máng yí gè ma
zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng ma
en: Could you do me a favour?
why: The count 一个 comes between 帮我 and 忙, not after 忙. 一个 is not a plain measure after the noun in Chinese.

q: 孩子们一边在院子里跳___舞，一边大声地笑。
zh: 孩子们一边在院子里跳着舞，一边大声地笑。
py: hái zi men yī biān zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào zhe wǔ yī biān dà shēng de xiào
en: The children were dancing in the yard and laughing loudly at the same time.
why: 一边…一边 describes two simultaneous ongoing actions, so the first verb takes 着 inside 跳舞: 跳着舞. 了, 过 and 完 would all close the action off.

zh: 妈妈没生你的气。
py: mā mā méi shēng nǐ de qì
en: Mum isn't angry with you.
why: The person goes inside 生气 as 你的; 没 negates the verb 生 in front.

src_py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
task: Put the object first and say the verb once.
zh: 他舞跳得很好。
py: tā wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
en: He dances very well.
why: The object 舞 is fronted and the verb is said once: 舞跳得很好. The repeated verb is only needed when the object follows it.

s: 孩子们唱歌着，大家都很高兴。
s_py: hái zi men chàng gē zhe dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng
zh: 孩子们唱着歌，大家都很高兴。
py: hái zi men chàng zhe gē dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng
en: The children were singing and everyone was happy.
why: 着 must attach to the verb half 唱, giving 唱着歌. 唱歌着 puts it after the object.

s: 孩子们昨天在学校打了一架。
s_py: hái zi men zuó tiān zài xué xiào dǎ le yī jià
zh: 孩子们昨天在学校打了一架。
py: hái zi men zuó tiān zài xué xiào dǎ le yī jià
en: The children had a fight at school yesterday.
why: 打了一架 is correct: a count can go after 了 with 一, and here 架 is simply the object slot. It is a correct, natural sentence.

zh: 我们没见过面。
py: wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
en: We have never met before.
why: 过 goes right after the verb half 见, not after 面: 见过面. 没 comes before the whole phrase.

q: 谢谢你帮了我___忙。
zh: 谢谢你帮了我的忙。
py: xiè xiè nǐ bāng le wǒ de máng
en: Thank you for helping me out.
why: The person helped goes inside 帮忙 as 我的, so 的 links 我 to 忙. 地 and 得 are different particles, and 着 cannot attach to a person.

q: 周末有空的话，来我家___吧。
zh: 周末有空的话，来我家聊聊天吧。
py: zhōu mò yǒu kòng de huà lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān ba
en: If you are free at the weekend, come to my place for a chat.
why: To say "a bit of" only the verb half 聊 is doubled: 聊聊天. 聊天聊天 is the ordinary-verb pattern, which does not work here.

q: 爸爸下个星期要___上海出差，所以不能陪我们去买东西。
zh: 爸爸下个星期要去上海出差，所以不能陪我们去买东西。
py: bà bà xià gè xīng qī yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi suǒ yǐ bù néng péi wǒ men qù mǎi dōng xī
en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business next week, so he cannot go shopping with us.
why: 出差 cannot take 上海 after it, so the destination is brought in front with 去 (go to Shanghai to do business). 把, 对 and 给 do not mean "go to" a place.

zh: 他只结过一次婚。
py: tā zhǐ jié guo yī cì hūn
en: He has only been married once.
why: 过 and the count 一次 both go inside 结婚: 结过一次婚.

src_py: dì di chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
task: Say what he is good at: add 唱歌 and repeat the verb.
zh: 弟弟唱歌唱得很好听。
py: dì di chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
en: My younger brother sings beautifully.
why: Adding the object 歌 means the verb must repeat before 得: 唱歌唱得很好听.

s: 他们结了十年婚，感情还是很好。
s_py: tā men jié le shí nián hūn gǎn qíng hái shì hěn hǎo
zh: 他们结婚十年了，感情还是很好。
py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le gǎn qíng hái shì hěn hǎo
en: They have been married for ten years and still get on well.
why: 结婚 happens at a point, so a duration cannot be placed inside it. The time since the wedding goes after 结婚 and 了 ends the clause.

q: 吃完饭，我们出去___吧。
zh: 吃完饭，我们出去散散步吧。
py: chī wán fàn wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
en: After dinner, let's go out for a little walk.
why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. 散步散步 treats the word like 休息休息, but 步 is its object, so it cannot repeat. 散步步 and 散步散 are not words.

s: 我们在商场见过面两次。
s_py: wǒ men zài shāng chǎng jiàn guo miàn liǎng cì
zh: 我们在商场见过两次面。
py: wǒ men zài shāng chǎng jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
en: We have met twice at the mall.
why: The count 两次 goes inside 见面, between 过 and 面. After 面 it would be a second object slot.

s: 你能帮我吗？我一个人拿不了这些东西。
s_py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma wǒ yí gè rén ná bù liǎo zhè xiē dōng xī
zh: 你能帮我吗？我一个人拿不了这些东西。
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma wǒ yí gè rén ná bù liǎo zhè xiē dōng xī
en: Can you help me? I can't carry all this by myself.
why: 帮 on its own can take 我 directly. The ban applies only to the whole word 帮忙 followed by a person, so this correct sentence is not an error.

q: 孩子还没洗___澡，不能马上出门。
zh: 孩子还没洗完澡，不能马上出门。
py: hái zi hái méi xǐ wán zǎo bù néng mǎ shàng chū mén
en: The child hasn't finished washing yet, so we can't go out right away.
why: Result 完 sits between 洗 and 澡: 洗完澡. The sense of "not finished yet" rules out 过 and 着, and 到 does not fit a bath.

q: 老板昨天开___一个下午的会，没有来店里。
zh: 老板昨天开了一个下午的会，没有来店里。
py: lǎo bǎn zuó tiān kāi le yí gè xià wǔ de huì méi yǒu lái diàn lǐ
en: The shop owner spent yesterday afternoon in a meeting and did not come to the shop.
why: Duration of a finished meeting: verb 了 + length + 的 + object, so 开了一个下午的会. 过 would turn it into an experience, and 着 or 完 are not used with a measured duration here.

s: 我们放假了，可以去外婆家玩。
s_py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù wài pó jiā wán
zh: 我们放假了，可以去外婆家玩。
py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù wài pó jiā wán
en: We are on holiday now, so we can go to Grandma's to play.
why: 放假了 with 了 at the end of the clause reports a new situation. It is correct, and splitting it into 放了假 would not be needed.

zh: 我们去海边散散步吧。
py: wǒ men qù hǎi biān sàn sàn bù ba
en: Let's go for a little walk by the sea.
why: Only the first half 散 is repeated: 散散步. 散步散步 does not exist.

s: 你太累了，回家休息休息吧。
s_py: nǐ tài lèi le huí jiā xiū xī xiū xī ba
zh: 你太累了，回家休息休息吧。
py: nǐ tài lèi le huí jiā xiū xī xiū xī ba
en: You are too tired; go home and rest for a bit.
why: 休息 is a normal verb and doubles as a whole word. This looks like the 散步散步 error but is correct.

zh: 她舞跳得非常好。
py: tā wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo
en: She dances extremely well.
why: With the object put first, the verb is said once and 得 follows it directly: 舞跳得非常好.

zh: 妹妹睡了九个小时觉。
py: mèi mèi shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: My younger sister slept for nine hours.
why: 了 and the duration both go between 睡 and 觉: 睡了九个小时觉. 睡觉了九个小时 is a classic error.

q: 天太热了，我想先洗___澡再出门。
zh: 天太热了，我想先洗个澡再出门。
py: tiān tài rè le wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo zài chū mén
en: It is so hot; I would like to take a shower before going out.
why: The casual 个 goes inside 洗澡 to make it a light, single shower: 洗个澡. 次, 本 and 张 do not fit a bath.

s: 他们已经结婚了，下个月搬家。
s_py: tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le xià gè yuè bān jiā
zh: 他们已经结婚了，下个月搬家。
py: tā men yǐ jīng jié hūn le xià gè yuè bān jiā
en: They are already married and will move house next month.
why: Sentence-final 了 after the whole word marks a change of state and is correct here. The rule about moving 了 inside only applies to verb 了 with a following clause or a count.

q: 爸爸上个月请___三天假，带我们去旅游。
zh: 爸爸上个月请了三天假，带我们去旅游。
py: bà bà shàng gè yuè qǐng le sān tiān jià dài wǒ men qù lǚ yóu
en: Last month Dad took three days off and took us travelling.
why: A specific completed leave of three days takes 了 inside the word: 请了三天假. 过 would only say he has had such leave at some time, and 着 and 完 do not fit.

q: 爸爸游泳___得很快。
zh: 爸爸游泳游得很快。
py: bà bà yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
en: Dad swims very fast.
why: The verb repeats so that 得 can attach to it: 游泳游得很快. Dropping the repeated verb leaves 得 after 泳, which is wrong.

zh: 你别生我的气了。
py: nǐ bié shēng wǒ de qì le
en: Stop being angry with me.
why: The person goes between the halves as 我的: 生我的气. 生气我 is not possible.

s: 我吃饭完了，你呢？
s_py: wǒ chī fàn wán le nǐ ne
zh: 我吃完饭了，你呢？
py: wǒ chī wán fàn le nǐ ne
en: I have finished eating; how about you?
why: 完 is a result complement that must follow the verb 吃 directly, before the object 饭. 吃饭完 puts it after the object.

task: Say he has been married before (experience), using 过.
zh: 他结过婚。
py: tā jié guo hūn
en: He has been married before.
why: Experience 过 attaches to the verb half: 结过婚. 结婚过 and 结婚了 would not express "has been married before".

q: 我昨天___妈妈的气了，因为她不让我出去玩。
zh: 我昨天生妈妈的气了，因为她不让我出去玩。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shēng mā mā de qì le yīn wèi tā bù ràng wǒ chū qù wán
en: I was angry with Mum yesterday because she wouldn't let me go out to play.
why: 生 + person + 的 + 气 is the frame, so the verb 生 must come right before 妈妈的. 对, 给 and 和 cannot take 妈妈的气 as their object.

zh: 爸爸要去上海出差。
py: bà bà yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business.
why: Place goes after 去 and before the verb 出差; 出差上海 would put an object after a verb that already holds its object.

q: 昨晚隔壁在装修，我没睡___觉，今天很困。
zh: 昨晚隔壁在装修，我没睡好觉，今天很困。
py: zuó wǎn gé bì zài zhuāng xiū wǒ méi shuì hǎo jiào jīn tiān hěn kùn
en: The neighbours were renovating last night, so I didn't sleep well and I'm sleepy today.
why: 没睡好觉 uses 好 as a result inside the word. 完 would mean the sleep was not finished, 过 means never, and 了 cannot follow 没.

zh: 孩子们洗完澡就睡觉了。
py: hái zi men xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào le
en: The children went to sleep as soon as they had finished bathing.
why: 完 is inside the first word: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is wrong because 完 must attach to the verb.

s: 我们上课完就去商店买东西。
s_py: wǒ men shàng kè wán jiù qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī
zh: 我们上完课就去商店买东西。
py: wǒ men shàng wán kè jiù qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī
en: We will go and buy things at the shop as soon as class finishes.
why: 完 belongs between 上 and 课, like 吃完饭. 上课完 puts the result after the object.

q: 老板娘算账算___特别快，从来不用计算器。
zh: 老板娘算账算得特别快，从来不用计算器。
py: lǎo bǎn niáng suàn zhàng suàn de tè bié kuài cóng lái bù yòng jì suàn qì
en: The owner's wife adds up the bills especially fast and never uses a calculator.
why: 得 links the repeated verb 算 to 特别快. 地 would modify a following verb, and 着 or 过 cannot introduce a degree description.

q: 我们正在客厅说___话，奶奶突然回来了。
zh: 我们正在客厅说着话，奶奶突然回来了。
py: wǒ men zhèng zài kè tīng shuō zhe huà nǎi nǎi tū rán huí lái le
en: We were chatting in the living room when Grandma suddenly came back.
why: An action in progress when something interrupts takes 着 attached to the verb half: 说着话. 过 or 完 would end the action and 了 would report it as finished.

q: 妈妈，您别生___的气了，我下次一定早点回家。
zh: 妈妈，您别生我的气了，我下次一定早点回家。
py: mā mā nín bié shēng wǒ de qì le wǒ xià cì yí dìng zǎo diǎn huí jiā
en: Mum, please don't be angry with me; next time I'll definitely come home earlier.
why: The pattern is 生 + person + 的 + 气, so only the bare 我 fits before 的气. 对我, 给我 or 跟我 cannot stand in front of 的气.

src_py: wǒ men qù hé biān sàn bù
task: Make it casual, "a little walk", by doubling.
zh: 我们去河边散散步。
py: wǒ men qù hé biān sàn sàn bù
en: Let's go for a little walk by the river.
why: Double only the verb half: 散散步. The object 步 stays alone.

q: 我昨晚睡___着觉，一直在想今天的考试。
zh: 我昨晚睡不着觉，一直在想今天的考试。
py: wǒ zuó wǎn shuì bù zháo jiào yì zhí zài xiǎng jīn tiān de kǎo shì
en: I couldn't fall asleep last night; I kept thinking about today's exam.
why: Potential form: 睡不着觉, with 不 between the verb and the result 着. 没, 别 and 不会 cannot sit between a verb and its result.

q: 我今天在理发店理___发，才花了三十块。
zh: 我今天在理发店理个发，才花了三十块。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zài lǐ fà diàn lǐ gè fā cái huā le sān shí kuài
en: I got a haircut at the barber's today and it cost only thirty yuan.
why: 个 inside 理发 gives a casual, single haircut: 理个发. 次, 本 and 张 do not fit and would be wrong whatever the price.

s: 晚上我想在家唱歌唱歌。
s_py: wǎn shàng wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chàng gē chàng gē
zh: 晚上我想在家唱唱歌。
py: wǎn shàng wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chàng chàng gē
en: I'd like to sing a bit at home tonight.
why: 唱歌 is verb + object, so only 唱 is doubled: 唱唱歌. Doubling the whole word is the error.

s: 我爸爸游泳游得不太快，但是他游得很久。
s_py: wǒ bà bà yóu yǒng yóu de bù tài kuài dàn shì tā yóu de hěn jiǔ
zh: 我爸爸游泳游得不太快，但是他游得很久。
py: wǒ bà bà yóu yǒng yóu de bù tài kuài dàn shì tā yóu de hěn jiǔ
en: My dad is not a very fast swimmer, but he can swim for a long time.
why: The second clause drops the object because 游泳 was already mentioned, so 他游得很久 is fine. The first clause repeats the verb correctly.

q: 哥哥和我小时候从来没打___架，感情一直很好。
zh: 哥哥和我小时候从来没打过架，感情一直很好。
py: gē gē hé wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cóng lái méi dǎ guo jià gǎn qíng yì zhí hěn hǎo
en: My brother and I never fought as children, and we have always got on well.
why: Never having done something takes 没…过, with 过 right after 打: 打过架. 没 rules out 了, and 着 and 完 do not mean experience.

s: 我想在商场门口见面你。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng zài shāng chǎng mén kǒu jiàn miàn nǐ
zh: 我想在商场门口跟你见面。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài shāng chǎng mén kǒu gēn nǐ jiàn miàn
en: I'd like to meet you at the entrance of the shopping mall.
why: 见面 already has its object 面, so 你 cannot follow it. English "meet you" must become 跟你见面, with the person before the verb.

q: 我一个人搬不动这个冰箱，你能不能帮我___忙？
zh: 我一个人搬不动这个冰箱，你能不能帮我一个忙？
py: wǒ yí gè rén bān bù dòng zhè ge bīng xiāng nǐ néng bù néng bāng wǒ yí gè máng
en: I can't move this fridge by myself; could you do me a favour?
why: The fixed expression is 帮我一个忙, with 一个 inside the word. 一件, 一本 and 一张 are not used with 忙.

zh: 我想先洗个澡。
py: wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
en: I want to take a shower first.
why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡 for a casual single bath. 洗澡个 puts it after the whole word.

s: 姐姐去年从大学毕业以后，就跟朋友一起开了一家小店。
s_py: jiě jiě qù nián cóng dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu jiù gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ kāi le yī jiā xiǎo diàn
zh: 姐姐去年从大学毕业以后，就跟朋友一起开了一家小店。
py: jiě jiě qù nián cóng dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu jiù gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ kāi le yī jiā xiǎo diàn
en: After my older sister graduated from university last year, she opened a small shop with a friend.
why: 从大学毕业 is fine: the school sits before the verb with 从, which is exactly where a place belongs. Nothing follows 毕业 here, so the sentence is correct.

q: 大家都___她鼓掌，因为她唱得太好了。
zh: 大家都给她鼓掌，因为她唱得太好了。
py: dà jiā dōu gěi tā gǔ zhǎng yīn wèi tā chàng de tài hǎo le
en: Everyone applauded her because she sang so well.
why: 鼓掌 is verb + object (clap palms), so the person applauded goes in front with 给. 被 would reverse the roles and 把 needs an object after the verb, which 鼓掌 cannot supply.

q: 爸爸工作十年，从来没请___假。
zh: 爸爸工作十年，从来没请过假。
py: bà bà gōng zuò shí nián cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià
en: Dad has worked for ten years and has never taken a day off.
why: Never-experienced with 从来没 needs 过, and it sits right after 请: 请过假. 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 or 完 do not express experience.

q: 你太累了，先___，晚上再去买东西吧。
zh: 你太累了，先休息休息，晚上再去买东西吧。
py: nǐ tài lèi le xiān xiū xī xiū xī wǎn shàng zài qù mǎi dōng xī ba
en: You are too tired. Have a little rest first and go shopping in the evening.
why: 休息 is an ordinary two-syllable verb, so it doubles whole: 休息休息. The other forms break the word; this is the contrast with 散步.

zh: 我哥哥大学毕业了。
py: wǒ gē gē dà xué bì yè le
en: My older brother has graduated from university.
why: The school is placed before 毕业, never after it (毕业大学). Sentence-final 了 stays after the whole word.

q: 我妹妹唱歌___得很好。
zh: 我妹妹唱歌唱得很好。
py: wǒ mèi mèi chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
en: My younger sister sings very well.
why: 得 must sit right after a verb, so 唱歌 is followed by a repeated 唱: 唱歌唱得很好. Leaving it out would put 得 after the noun 歌.

s: 妈妈睡觉了一个下午。
s_py: mā mā shuì jiào le yí gè xià wǔ
zh: 妈妈睡了一个下午觉。
py: mā mā shuì le yí gè xià wǔ jiào
en: Mum slept all afternoon.
why: 了 and the duration belong between 睡 and 觉. Attaching them after the whole word 睡觉 is wrong.

src_py: wǒ jiàn dào le gū gū
task: Say you met up with her, using 见面.
zh: 我跟姑姑见面了。
py: wǒ gēn gū gū jiàn miàn le
en: I met up with my aunt.
why: Replace 见到 + object with 见面, which has no object slot, so the aunt moves in front as 跟姑姑.

zh: 有空来我家聊聊天。
py: yǒu kòng lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān
en: Come over to my place for a chat when you have time.
why: 聊聊天 doubles only the verb 聊. 有空 stays at the front as the condition.

s: 我姐姐下个月要结婚小王。
s_py: wǒ jiě jiě xià gè yuè yào jié hūn xiǎo wáng
zh: 我姐姐下个月要跟小王结婚。
py: wǒ jiě jiě xià gè yuè yào gēn xiǎo wáng jié hūn
en: My older sister is marrying Xiao Wang next month.
why: 结婚 does not take an object, so 小王 cannot follow it. Chinese says you marry "with" someone: 跟小王结婚.

zh: 他向老师道歉了。
py: tā xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn le
en: He apologised to the teacher.
why: The person apologised to goes before 道歉 with 向; it cannot follow 道歉. 了 closes the sentence after the whole word.

s: 我昨天睡觉得很晚。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào de hěn wǎn
zh: 我昨天睡觉睡得很晚。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
why: 睡觉 needs the verb 睡 repeated before 得: 睡觉睡得很晚. 睡觉得很晚 puts 得 after 觉.

q: 我们只见过两___面。
zh: 我们只见过两次面。
py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
en: We have only met twice.
why: The number of times goes inside the word after 过: 见过两次面. 个, 本 and 条 are measure words for things, not for repeated events.

zh: 周末我去给奶奶帮忙。
py: zhōu mò wǒ qù gěi nǎi nǎi bāng máng
en: I'm going to help Grandma out this weekend.
why: With 帮忙 the helped person is introduced before the verb by 给, since 帮忙奶奶 cannot take an object after it.

q: 我爸妈结婚___三十年了，从来没吵过架。
zh: 我爸妈结婚三十年了，从来没吵过架。
py: wǒ bà mā jié hūn sān shí nián le cóng lái méi chǎo guo jià
en: My parents have been married for thirty years and have never quarrelled.
why: 结婚 is a point-in-time event, so the time since it goes after the whole word with nothing inside: 结婚三十年了. 结了三十年婚 and 结婚了三十年 are not said.
